Located near our Design Center, the facility plays an important role in how we prototype, test, refine and manufacture the technical gear we are known for.
Some of our most technically complex products including Alpha SV and new product pilots are built here. The facility also supports ReBIRD repair and renewal programs, helping extend the life of Arc’teryx gear.
This is hands-on, precision work where craftsmanship, problem-solving and continuous improvement come together on the production floor. This is Who We Are .
For our ever-growing operation, we are looking for Press Machine Operators to join our teams.

Developing your skills is our priority. Thanks to our continuing Learning & Development Program you will acquire new skills on new products (eg: jackets, pants, or gear) . Quality first. You will review, troubleshoot, and repair any quality control issues with the Quality Control Inspector and your Team Leader and/or Supervisor
Evolve is our DNA, you will champion it, and you will partner with your team to identify areas of improvement in order to be better than yesterday
In cross-learning we trust, you will be continually challenged in developing your skills and to be able to help all the production lines, if need it
Here are some of the things you could be working on in the future:
By combining your willingness to learn and our continuing Learning & Development Program, you will be able to climb our 9 skill levels. You will master the pressing operations .
Are you our future Press Machine Operator?
You have a minimum of 1-year experience in a fast-paced work environment (eg: manufacturing, food services, hospitality)
Our teams are multicultural so communicating in English is not a problem for you, even if it is not your mother tongue
